answer: One workable defence is stake-anchored work history: every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and that stake is slashed if peers prove its answers copied or false. A public beacon publishes random spot-check tasks so no identity can precompute a fake record, while a reputation nebula of linked endorsements grows only through real attested work. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real money per identity, and one detected fraud wipes the whole cluster's stake, making sybil farming unprofitable while honest newcomers pay only a small temporary deposit.
